# our special offers
Enjoy our enticing deals to complement the season, a cultural celebration or a special event. Offering exciting room package combining special delights from our restaurants and spa treatment along with extra savings. 
Bookmark this page and check back from time to time for all the latest special offers for our rooms, restaurants and spa. 
### New Year 2027: Feast & Folly in the Square
Inspired by the charm of a medieval town square, gather for a festive celebration filled with feasting, music, lively entertainment, and joyful moments. Welcome 2027 surrounded by merriment by the sea.
Validity: Direct bookings for a one-night stay (31 December 2026 – 1 January 2027).
Inclusions:
  * Breakfast for 2 adults and 2 children under 5 years old
  * New Year’s Eve Gala Dinner for 2 persons
  * F&B snack stall vouchers
  * Access to resort activities
  * Live band, DJ, and dance performances
  * New Year’s Eve fireworks show
  * Special souvenirs and doorprizes


Early bird pricing available for bookings made before 1 December 2026
Rate from IDR 3,957,600++/ 1 night, 2 adults [Book Now](https://www.novushotels.com/novusjiva/promo-hotel-anyer)
### Midweek Full Reset
Take a break from the usual routine with a midweek escape designed to help you slow down, recharge, and enjoy more of the coast.
Validity: All direct website bookings for minimum two-night stays from 1 October – 13 December 2026, Sunday–Thursday. Offer applies to Mountain Sunrise View, Cozy Garden View, Cozy Garden Patio & Cozy Garden Ocean View rooms.
Inclusions:
  * Room upgrade (subject to availability)
  * Early check-in & late check-out (subject to availability)
  * Breakfast for two
  * One-time Breakfast on the Beach
  * Free-flow mocktails at Barefoot from 9 AM–5 PM for two
  * Free-flow coffee & tea at Sarasa for two, during operating hours
  * IDR 200,000 nett Dining Destination Voucher
  * IDR 300,000 nett Daiva Spa Voucher per reservation, minimum 2 treatments
  * Game Card with 3 sessions


### Luxury Coastal Escape
Escape to a more indulgent side of Novus Jiva in our Seaside Pool Villa, thoughtful experiences, and exclusive privileges throughout your stay. 
Validity: All direct website bookings for stays from 1 October – 13 December 2026, Sunday–Thursday. Offer applies to Seaside Pool Villa. 
Inclusions:
  * Villa upgrade up to Premium Seaside (subject to availability)
  * Early check-in & late check-out (subject to availability)
  * Free-flow mocktails at Barefoot
  * Free-flow coffee & tea at Sarasa for two
  * One-time Breakfast on the Beach
  * IDR 200,000 nett Dining Destination Voucher
  * IDR 350,000 nett Daiva Spa Voucher per reservation, minimum 2 treatments
  * Game Card with 5 sessions
  * Turndown service, including complimentary cake and amenity replacement
  * Special gift upon check-out


### Bluewave Family Holiday
Luxury by the sea, made for families. Stay in our two-bedroom villa with a private infinity pool, and enjoy exclusive experiences designed for quality time together. 
Validity: All direct website bookings for stays from 1 August – 30 November 2026. Offer applies to Bluewave Pool Villa. 
Inclusions:
  * Breakfast for four with free upgrade to Breakfast on the Beach
  * The Bluewave Private BBQ Dinner for four
  * Premium High Tea Set at Sarasa Lounge for four
  * One complimentary extra bed with breakfast
  * Complimentary room upgrade on additional bookings (subject to availability
  * Early check-in & late check-out (subject to availability)
  * Complimentary laundry service (4 pieces per day)
  * Welcome gift
  * Family Fun Game
  * IDR75,000 Game Voucher
  * 15% discount at Daiva Spa
  * 15% dining discount (excluding alcohol)
  * Free-flow mocktails at Barefoot (9 AM–5 PM) for two

## inhouse promo
![](https://www.novushotels.com/img/novusjiva/promotion/food/hilltop-romantic-dinner-anyer.jpg)
### Hilltop Romantic Dinner
Experience a serene dinner surrounded by majestic trees on the hilltop, where the gentle sea breeze creates a tranquil ambiance. 
##### IDR 380,000++/pax (max. 10 pax)
![](https://www.novushotels.com/img/novusjiva/promotion/activities/yoga-by-the-beach-jiva.jpg)
### Yoga by the beach
Novus Jiva invites you to join our Yoga class on the BAREFOOT BEACH! 
Every Saturday & Tuesday at 8 AM At Barefoot Beach
Validity: until December 2026
![](https://www.novushotels.com/img/novusjiva/promotion/activities/fire-dance-on-the-beach.jpg)
### Fire Dance
Come and watch our Fire Dancer perform and watch as his flame impresses you! Every Friday and Saturday at 17.45 at our BAREFOOT BEACH. 
Validity: until December 2026
![](https://www.novushotels.com/img/novusjiva/promotion/activities/fun-game.jpg)
### Fun Games
Enjoy the fun games at Our BAREFOOT BEACH; multiple fun games for you and your family can compete with each other right next to the ocean and the sunset. 
Every day from 17.00-17.30 at Barefoot Beach
Validity: until December 2026
![](https://www.novushotels.com/img/novusjiva/promotion/food/marshmallow.jpg)
### Marshmallow Time
Enjoy the sunset time by experiencing a bonfire by the beach with your family, accompanied by marshmallows at our Barefoot Beach. 
Every Friday, Saturday & Sunday from 5 - 5.30 PM at Barefoot Beach 
Validity: until December 2026
![](https://www.novushotels.com/img/novusjiva/promotion/food/cooking-class-promo-jiva.jpg)
### Cooking Class for Little Chefs
A fun, hands-on cooking experience where children aged 4–10 can learn, create, and enjoy their own delicious treats. 
Available every Sunday
Complimentary for in-house guests.  
Advance reservation required, one day prior (D-1). 
![](https://www.novushotels.com/img/novusjiva/promotion/activities/bike-around-jiva-resort.jpg)
### Bike Around the Resort
Explore the resort at your own pace and enjoy the fresh coastal breeze on a leisurely bike ride. 
Every day
##### From IDR 121,000 nett for 2 hours.
Please inquire at the Front Office.
![](https://www.novushotels.com/img/novusjiva/promotion/food/bonfire-dinner-novus-jiva.jpg)
